title: Blackstone to own about 16% of IIFL Finance

timeline.title: Blackstone leads ₹6,414 crore IIFL Finance raise
timeline.line: Blackstone funds to invest ₹5,000 crore via convertible preference shares at ₹602
more: Promoters add ₹1,264 crore via warrants; Anchorage Capital ₹150 crore
Board approved the preferential issue on November 10
Conversion into equity is due within 18 months of allotment

timeline.title: Blackstone to own about 16% of IIFL Finance
timeline.line: The ₹5,000 crore Blackstone investment does not change control, the company says
more: The capital raise is expected to lift capital adequacy from about 17% to 30% pro forma
The stake is about 15.57%, per a Quartz report
IIFL Finance shares are among the morning's stocks in focus
